title: Neotenic expansion of adult-born dentate granule cells reconfigures GABAergic inhibition to enhance social memory consolidation
title_zh: 成年期新生齿状颗粒细胞的幼态持续扩展重塑GABA能抑制以增强社会记忆巩固
abstract: Immature adult-born dentate granule cells (abDGCs) show heightened synaptic and structural plasticity and preferentially contribute to hippocampal-dependent memory. Protracted maturation (neoteny) of abDGCs in higher mammals is posited to offset the decline in adult hippocampal neurogenesis by supporting increased plasticity. Here we found that selective, synchronous expansion of 4-week-old immature, but not 8-week-old mature, mouse abDGCs promotes recruitment of fast-spiking parvalbumin-expressing inhibitory interneurons (INs) in hippocampal CA3 and CA2, increases feed-forward inhibition, decreases social memory interference and enhances social memory consolidation. In vivo local field potential recordings in dorsal CA1 and CA2 revealed increased baseline power, amplitude and duration of sharp-wave ripples, as well as enhanced rate modulation by social experience. Inhibitory neuron-targeted chemogenetic manipulations implicate dorsal CA3 and CA2 INs, including parvalbumin-expressing INs, as necessary and sufficient for social memory consolidation following and sans neotenic expansion of abDGCs, respectively. Our findings suggest that neoteny of abDGCs supports cognition by increasing feed-forward inhibition in DG–CA3 and DG–CA2 and promoting network oscillations that underlie memory consolidation. This study describes a circuit mechanism by which immature adult-born dentate granule cells promote network oscillations to support memory consolidation.
abstract_zh: 成年期新生齿状颗粒细胞（abDGCs）表现出增强的突触和结构可塑性，并优先参与依赖海马的记忆。高等哺乳动物中abDGCs的成熟延迟（幼态持续）被认为通过支持增加的可塑性来抵消成年期海马神经发生的下降。本研究发现，选择性同步扩展4周龄未成熟、而非8周龄成熟的小鼠abDGCs，促进海马CA3和CA2区快速放电伴白蛋白抑制性神经元（INs）的招募，增加前馈抑制，减少社会记忆干扰，并增强社会记忆巩固。背侧CA1和CA2的体内局部场电位记录显示，基线功率、尖锐波-高频振荡的幅度和持续时间增加，以及社会经验导致的速率调制增强。针对抑制性神经元的化学遗传操纵表明，背侧CA3和CA2区INs（包括伴白蛋白抑制性神经元）分别是abDGCs幼态持续扩展后社会记忆巩固所必需且足够的，以及在无abDGCs幼态持续扩展时所必需且足够的。我们的研究结果表明，abDGCs的幼态持续通过增加DG–CA3和DG–CA2中的前馈抑制以及促进支撑记忆巩固的网络振荡来支持认知。本研究描述了一种电路机制，即成年期新生齿状颗粒细胞促进网络振荡以支持记忆巩固。
